normal.name: App Inquirer
normal.text: How many people does it take to build a hit? Wordle: 1. Stardew Valley: 1. Instagram: 13, when it sold for $1 billion. WhatsApp: 55. If you're building something on your own right now, you're in good company.
normal.media: 4 images: Wordle: 1 person. One software engineer made it as a game for his partner. Then: Nov 1, 2021, 90 people played. Now: 2025, 4.2 billion puzzles solved. / Stardew Valley: 1 person. One developer spent four years making it alone. Then: Feb 2016, released on PC. Now: Feb 2026, 50 million copies sold. / Instagram: 13 people. The whole company was 13 people when it sold. Then: 2012, sold for $1 billion. Now: 2025, 3 billion monthly users. / WhatsApp: 55 people. The whole company was 55 people when Facebook agreed to buy it. Then: 2014, a $19 billion deal. Now: 2025, 3 billion+ monthly users.
